notes: Reactor hidden photon search reinterpreting TEXONO data. Limit is on kinetic mixing epsilon vs mX. The paper's Fig.1 shows the exclusion but only axis ranges (Log10 eps from -15 to 0, Log10 mX from -2 to 6) are given; no numerical table. Data points are rough estimates for mX >~ 20 eV where P~eps^2 gives a limit slightly weaker than Ref[13]'s ~1e-5. Sensitivity vanishes below ~0.05-20 eV due to plasma mass suppression.
